query:
SELECT id, companyName, isActive,
  SUBSTRING(coreCapabilities, 1, 80) as cap_raw,
  SUBSTRING(fitCriteria, 1, 80) as fit_raw,
  SUBSTRING(urgencyTriggers, 1, 80) as urgency_raw
FROM offering_brain
WHERE isActive = 1
LIMIT 1;
